title: くじけぬガッツ、みなぎるパワー

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey, Kawakami! I'm back!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, I've gone and mucked it up again!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see… Are you making another figure for the Princess Fighter figure sculpting contest?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes, but no matter how many times I try, my clay turns into a complete mess…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh, don't let yourself fall into a funk!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The most important thing is communicating your feelings and passion! I thought your feelings toward Princess Fighter were more positive and powerful than this!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ah! B-but of course! Princess Fighter is my guiding light—the very source of my determination!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, that's what I thought. If you're not good at working with clay, why not try another material that can better showcase your ability?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What an excellent proposal! I think I'll try my hand at wood carving, then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl contacts me, saying she wants to carve wooden sculptures in the academy's forest. I manage to secure the school's permission, and…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: All right, Kawakami! Let's get carving!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Very well! I'm going to turn this wooden log into a huge Princess Fighter figure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: VREEEN! TATATATA!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh no! The part I just shaved down snapped in half!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaah! I only wanted to chip off a little, but it completely broke off!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Aaargh! Why is wood carving so difficult?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hmm… You hacked away at it so enthusiastically that it turned out more like a kokeshi doll than a Princess Fighter figure…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Urgh, you're right… This is barely a step above being a plain stick!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That said, its sharp and linear silhouette does have a certain charm to it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh… Do you really think so?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The way you carved it is like a pure reflection of your straightforward feelings! Bravo!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Goodness, do you truly think so highly of it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I do! You should make use of your artistic ability to really bring out this unique charm from your work!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: My word! I knew I had artistic ability inside of me!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: All right! I'll stay true to myself and continue hacking away in a straightforward manner, then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess continues to saw away chunks of the log until what's left of her carving is one boldly linear rod!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh! Why, this…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: This looks just like the magic wand they used in the Princess Fighter movie, Magical Love☆Princess Fighter !

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Well, that's just grand! In that case, you can submit this as a replica of that wand!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: All that's left is to carve out the heart shape at the end of it! Hraaah!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's complete! ☆ Not only did you make great use of the log's sheer size in bringing this wand to life, the heart at its end possesses a powerful weightiness as well! It's perfect, Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Right, let's hurry and enter it into the contest!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Okay! Umm, let's see… Let me just check the contest entry page again… Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh nooo! This can't be!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The log-sized figure is larger than the maximum size specified for the contest. As such, they're unlikely to accept her entry.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Urgh… And after all that trouble of making it… How disappointing…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh my, don't feel bad! There must be something we can do to share your work of art.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you have any ideas?
choice_data_list: How about placing it in the park as a decoration?
How about posting it online as fan art?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Great idea! Let's go talk to the neighborhood association right away!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's huge! I wanna climb on it!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: I made it up to the big bump at the top! Hehe, this is fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, after displaying the log wand in the park, it becomes a popular attraction for kids to climb on.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fantastic idea! We can use the magic wand as a prop and shoot a Princess Fighter video! I'll play the villain!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I-in that case, there's a special move I want to try out! I'm going to cast a special magic spell, so pretend to take it head on, Pearl!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: This is the end! Give it up, Dark Umamusume Pearl! Take this! Magical☆Don't Mooove!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Argh! The weight of the wand is making it impossible for me to move!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: HYAAAH! PRINCESS IMPAAACT!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohhh nooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some days later, the video they posted on online catches everyone's attention and ends up going viral.
